_note: Maps speaker roles to ElevenLabs voices. defaultVoiceId values are public voice IDs (not secrets) and may be overridden by the matching env var. The API key is never stored here — only ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on the server. Resolution for a role: env var if set, else that role's defaultVoiceId, then each fallback the same way, ending at the narrator (Roger).

narrator.cast: Roger — narrator, speech tags, and the final fallback for every role

jesus.cast: Kai — Jesus, and the default divine voice for the LORD

the_lord.cast: The LORD. Optional dedicated God voice (ELEVENLABS_VOICE_GOD); otherwise Kai, then Roger

peter.cast: Brian — Peter, and the default voice for Abram (main human character)

abram.cast: Abram. Optional ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ABRAM; otherwise Brian, then Roger. No spoken lines in Genesis 12:1-9.

pharaoh.cast: Pharaoh. Optional; otherwise Roger. No spoken lines in Genesis 12:1-9.
